draft.title: A outra passagem
draft.summary: Malu encontra as passagens e teme que Laranjito deixe o apartamento. Ele revela que a outra passagem pertence a ela; Malu pede que explique o segredo.

scenes.narration_text: Você ia embora sem me contar?
scenes.prompt: Warm sunset apartment with plants and a blue door. Medium close-up at eye level. The single visible speaker turns slightly toward the off-screen partner, shoulders tense, with restrained hurt. Keep hands below frame and the face clearly visible.

Same warm sunset apartment, plants and blue door. Reverse medium close-up at eye level with coherent eyeline. The single visible speaker leans forward slightly with sincere reassurance, keeping hands below frame and the face clearly visible.

Same warm sunset apartment with plants and a blue door. Slightly tighter eye-level close-up of the single visible speaker. Her shoulders soften before a small questioning head tilt toward the off-screen partner. Keep hands below frame and the face clearly visible.
